xhtml:div.xhtml:span: A consulting herald assists in making the submission as likely to pass as possible and/or in filling out the paperwork
The submission is sent, with fees, to the appropriate staff herald (Submission/Internal Submission)
The appropriate staff herald compiles all submissions for a month onto an Internal Letter of Intent
Commenting heralds spend approximately a month commenting on a given Internal Letter of Intent
A meeting is held by the appropriate staff herald (Submission/External Submission) to determine whether each item, with commentary in mind, should be Returned or Forwarded
Submitter redesigns, ideally with consultation, and resubmits
The appropriate staff herald (Submission/External Submission) compiles a Letter of Intent for commentary at the Society-wide “Laurel” level
Commenting heralds spend approximately 2 months commenting on Letters of Intent
A meeting is held by Laurel & Staff to determine whether to accept or return each item
Decisions are placed on a Letter of Acceptances and Returns, which is proofread for 1–2 months
Item is Accepted and officially Registered!

This is a brief overview, eliding over the systems and people that make each step happen. The College is a vast, sophisticated system full of hardworking and dedicated volunteers, many of them sight unseen.
